messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D Metroidvania starring Frogo, an armored frog with cape and sword, exploring five kingdoms to investigate a deadly illness affecting an ancient Paris-inspired city and his family.

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a standalone HTML canvas experience with keyboard and touch controls.
- Added five themed realms, collectible seals, enemies/guardians, NPC dialogue, a map, and an ending.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with the game, UI, story, controls, rendering, and gameplay systems.
- JavaScript syntax check passed with `node --check /tmp/frogo-check.js`.
- Served locally and checked the title and gameplay screenshots at `/tmp/opencode/frogo-title.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/frogo-play.jpg`.
